description: Generate an original AI image with optional meme captions. Use when no existing template fits. Slower (~10-30s) and more expensive (3 credits) than caption/generate, but uniquely flexible. If it runs past ~50s you get a result id — collect via createa_check_generation.

caption_top.description: Optional top caption. Combine with caption_bottom for a classic meme.

prompt.description: What to draw, e.g. "a confused cat looking at deployment errors".

watermark.description: Optional brand watermark (Starter+ plans only). Provide either "text" OR "logo_url". Defaults: bottom-right, 65% opacity, white-on-dark text legible on any background.

logo_url.description: Public URL of a logo image to stamp instead of text.

scale.description: Logo width as a fraction of image width (logo mode).

name: createa_meme_ai_image
